reviews.summary: 本评审只读冻结材料，按能力单元评估 NocoBase3 基础框架在 issue #543（项目资料与私有附件）中的支撑度。核心结论：框架把“文件上传/存储/元数据”与“公开字节路由”解耦得很清楚，公开字节路由被注释、文档与 Skill 一并标为“有意的例外”，并明确要求应用为受限文件自建认证；应用据此只挂 api action 并自建按 ownerId 过滤的认证字节路由，B05 私有隔离通过。不足集中在内容读取的复用性（无带主体的读取 API，应用复制安全头与流逻辑）、客户端预览失败态（图片分支无 onError）与 OOOXML 无加载超时、以及 uuid 主键身份职责在 db Skill 中未写清。verify-2 的全项失败经日志证实是 implement 轮次被自动压缩截断、功能代码未写出（工厂侧），repair-2 后 verify-3 除 B02 外均通过；B02 是 agent-browser 包装 window.Worker 造成的环境阻塞。评审未发现导致验收失败的框架实现缺陷，但识别出若干可复用性与健壮性改进点。

modules.scope: @nocobase/db 的 Repository 主键选择与 createOne 身份约定、迁移 API，以及 nocobase-db Skill 对“id 假设”的指引。

requirements.need: uuid 主键在无数据库默认值时的身份生成职责要明确。
requirements.responsibility: 文档/Skill 应明确，或库提供默认

requirements.actualUsage: 应用在 service/route 层按 ownerId 过滤并传 filter；写操作经 service 收敛。

findings.title: File Repository 的上传/元数据/内容路由契约完整且默认行为有明确文档
findings.detail: defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 把 actions、必填 policy、principal 解析、disk 与 accessPath 组合成一套契约：上传路径由 store() 合成全部值（randomUUID、objects/<id>.<ext>、文件名清洗、size 一致性校验），Policy 以 create.scope/defaults 约束且只做必要放宽；accessPath 下的公开字节路由被注释与 docs/README 明确标为“有意的例外”。Skill 进一步指出受限文件应由应用自建认证并保留其余授权检查，同时明确“missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes”。
findings.impact: 应用无需重建文件模块即可获得安全的字节落盘与元数据，且能按文档把私有化责任放在应用侧，避免误把公开路由当安全边界。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持该契约；可考虑把 material-content.ts 这类“认证字节路由”抽成官方可复用模式或示例，减少重复实现。

findings.title: ServerFileRepository 缺少带主体过滤的内容读取 API，应用只能重写整套字节路由
findings.detail: FileOperations 只提供 validateCollection/uploadOne/uploadMany/getUrl/getStorageUrl，公开字节路由又是无认证的例外。要满足“附件仅本人可读”，应用别无选择：解析 driveManagerToken 与 databaseManagerToken，在 material-content.ts 里自己写 UUID 正则、ownerId 过滤、disk.exists、404 语义、Cache-Control/nosniff/CSP/Content-Disposition，再用 Readable.toWeb(getStream) 返回字节——与插件 routes.js 中公开路由的实现几乎逐行重复。Skill 要求应用“先加 scoped middleware 和 principal-based Policy”，但公开 ServerFileRepositoryManager 并未暴露可承载这层 Policy 的读取入口。
findings.impact: 每个需要私有附件的应用都要复制一遍易错的安全头、404 等价性与流式实现；不同实现的细微差异（例如漏掉 nosniff 或把越权记录当成 200）难以被框架约束。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 ServerFileRepositoryManager/FileOperations 上提供可选主体上下文的读取/流式方法（或在 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 内建应用可注入的认证与授权钩子），让应用复用同一套安全头与记录判定。

findings.title: 注册表图片预览器缺少失败态，损坏 PNG 会被静默当作成功预览
findings.detail: file-preview-content.tsx 的 image 分支直接渲染裸 ，没有 onError，也没有围绕加载失败的状态或下载回退（外部 error prop 只覆盖调用方已知错误）。相较之下 Office/OOXML 分支都有 error → 下载卡片的回退。于是损坏 PNG 会保留浏览器坏图标，而周围 UI 仍显示文件名，看起来像“预览成功”。应用为了满足 B06，只能在 app-owned 的注册表副本里新增 ImagePreview（onError + role=alert + 下载按钮）。

findings.suggestedChange: 在框架的 image 分支内建 onError 失败态与下载回退（可复用现有 office 回退组件），使所有复用者默认获得一致行为。

findings.title: OfficeOpenXmlPreview 没有加载超时，viewer 卡住时会永久停在 Loading preview…
findings.detail: OOXML 预览只在 !loaded 时显示 “Loading preview…”，viewer 若既没有 onError 也不完成 load（例如 worker 被运行环境包装后丢消息），界面会无限等待且没有失败回退。旧版 Office iframe 路径则定义了 OFFICE_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000。file-preview-content.tsx 只对 office（iframe）分支有超时，ooxml 分支没有。
findings.impact: 预览链路的任何挂起都会表现为“永远加载”，用户与自动化都拿不到成功或失败的确定结果，问题也难以归因。
findings.suggestedChange: 为 OOXML 预览加入与旧 Office 一致的加载超时（例如复用 OFFICE_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT_MS），超时后走 viewerError → 下载回退。

findings.title: db Skill 未说明 uuid 主键无数据库默认值时需由调用方提供 id
findings.detail: nocobase-db SKILL 的边界清单写了 “Do not assume an `id` exists…”，方向正确但没有覆盖最常见的正向场景：用 collection.uuid("id").primary() 声明的主键没有数据库默认值，Repository 的 createdRecordSelector 只回填 autoIncrement/increments，因此 createOne 省略 id 时会由 recordSelector 抛 INVALID_UNIQUE_SELECTOR。应用为此在 provider 里显式 id: randomUUID()。迁移模板与 Skill 都没有把这一职责写清楚。
findings.impact: 使用 uuid 主键的开发者会先撞上运行时的 INVALID_UNIQUE_SELECTOR，再自行推断出“需要自己铸 id 或加数据库默认”，增加试错成本并容易在不同表间写出不一致的身份策略。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 nocobase-db Skill（及迁移示例）中补一段：uuid primary 无默认值时，createOne/upsertOne 必须显式提供 id（或声明数据库默认/服务端默认），并给出 randomUUID 示例。

improvements.title: Seed context methods must stay attached to their object
improvements.detail: Destructuring `repository` from SeedContext separates a method from its receiver and trips @typescript-eslint/unbound-method; typing raw query builders as `any` trips the whole no-unsafe-* family.
improvements.suggestedChange: In seeds use `context.repository(...)` (or keep the method bound) and type QueryAdapter parameters with the exported `QueryAdapter` type from @nocobase/db instead of `any`.

improvements.title: A uuid primary key without a database default needs the id supplied by the caller
improvements.detail: `Repository.createOne` builds its selector from the record and throws `INVALID_UNIQUE_SELECTOR` when the primary key is a uuid column with no DB default and the value is omitted. A Collection Builder uuid primary key does not imply a database default, so application code must mint the id (like the File Repository's own upload path does) or declare a default in the migration.
improvements.suggestedChange: When the intent is an application-owned identity, set a database default (e.g. `defaultTo`/`gen_random_uuid`) in the migration, or make createOne mint a uuid for a missing primary key. Until then document the requirement on the Collection Builder uuid helper.

improvements.title: Reset derived component state with a key instead of a setState effect
improvements.detail: `useEffect(() => setState(x), [dep])` trips eslint-react's `set-state-in-effect` (cascading render) and is the pattern the framework flags. Remounting the child with `key={dep}` resets its state without an effect.
improvements.suggestedChange: When state must reset on an identity/prop change, key the component on that value and let the remount clear the state rather than writing a setState-in-effect.

Skill 明确：action 由 policy 管，accessPath 下的内容路由是公开例外；“For restricted files, register App-owned authentication … before mounting it”；“missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes”。
evidence.excerpt:
Only declared POST `/api/<name>:<action>` operations are exposed. Ordinary actions are `findMany/findOne/count/exists/aggregate/groupBy/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne`. There are no createMany/updateMany/deleteMany HTTP actions.

`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. Pass a function of the principal — `policy: (principal) => ({ ... })` — together with a `principal(context)` resolver to scope rows to the caller; without a principal the request is refused with 403.

An upload supplies no caller fields, so it binds a Policy derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are inherited and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns. `create: false` therefore forbids uploading as well as creating metadata, and a `create.defaults` of `{ ownerId }` is stamped onto uploaded rows — which is what keeps an uploaded file inside the same scope `findMany` reads. The content route under `accessPath` is the exception: it is public and this Policy does not reach it.

Content is GET `<accessPath>/<uuid>.<ext>` outside `/api`, omitting the dot when extensionless. Stream returns full bytes as an attachment; redirect returns a public storage URL or a five-minute signed URL. A disk without URL support requires stream mode; there is no automatic fallback.

These are public routes. For restricted files, register App-owned authentication and authorization on the paths each contribution owns before mounting it — `/<name>:<action>` per exposed API action, `<accessPath>/*` for content. Never `router.use('*', ...)` in a contribution router: contributions share the mounted router, so it also guards the SPA and every contribution mounted after yours. Check the operation and record/parent-record access; a login page, private disk, Client filter or Policy field allowlist is not authentication. Add scoped middleware and principal-based Policy to the generated routes first. If an existing contract needs an adapter, extend that module using the public Server manager and retain its authorization checks; missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes. Never trust browser-supplied ownership.

evidence.observation: 指引给出 auth.required()/auth.optional() 的 401 行为、AuthEnv 形状、skip 选项与 getSession 语义。
evidence.excerpt:
## The two middlewares

- `auth.required()` rejects an anonymous request with `401` and the body
  `{ code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Authentication required' }`. On success
  `context.get('auth')` is `{ user, session }`.
- `auth.optional()` sets `context.get('auth')` to the session or `null` and
  never rejects. Use it for a route whose response differs for a signed-in
  caller but is still public.

Both accept `{ skip: (context) => boolean }` to exempt specific requests, for
example a health probe inside an otherwise protected prefix. A skipped request
has no `auth` variable at all; read it only after checking.

`AuthEnv` is `{ Variables: { auth: AuthSession } }`. Type the router with it so
`context.get('auth')` compiles. `AuthSession` is `{ user, session } | null`;
`user` carries `id`, `name`, `email`, `emailVerified`, `username`, `image`,
`disabledAt`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, plus any `user.additionalFields` the
application configured.

## What a session means

`auth.getSession(headers)` is what both middlewares call. It asks Better Auth
for the cookie's session and then re-reads the user row: a user that no longer
exists or has `disabledAt` set yields `null` even though the cookie is still
valid. That is why disabling an account takes effect immediately for HTTP.

Use `getSession` directly when you have a `Request` but no Hono context, for
example in a WebSocket upgrade or a job that validates a caller-supplied
request. Do not call Better Auth's `api.getSession` yourself; it skips the
disabled check.

evidence.observation: db Skill 的边界清单：包含 “Do not assume an `id` exists…”；但没有说明 uuid 主键在未声明数据库默认值时必须由调用方提供 id。
evidence.excerpt:
Boundaries that are easy to get wrong:

- `findOne` takes the first match; `updateOne` and `deleteOne` require exactly one; `upsertOne` requires a unique equality condition.
- `updateMany` and `deleteMany` refuse an empty scope. Pass `all: true` only when the task explicitly calls for every row — never to make an error go away.
- `createMany` and `updateMany` do not accept nested relation writes. `createOne` accepts `create` and `connect` on a relation, not the full set.
- `disconnect` detaches; `delete` removes the target record. A relation target update or delete stays inside the current parent record's scope.
- Repository does not apply the application's permissions. A route handler decides what the caller may see and change _before_ anything reaches `filter`, `values` or `select`. `writePolicy` defaults to `true` for an internal Repository and `false` for one reached from an API route, so a route-facing Repository needs an explicit allow list.
- Do not assume an `id` exists, and do not infer a field's type, primary key or auto-increment from its name.

evidence.observation: 文件插件文档用中文复述：actions 只管开端点、policy 管能做什么、上传绑定派生 Policy，以及 “accessPath 下的内容路由是有意的例外”。
evidence.excerpt:
这是全部 action 的配置示例，实际使用只保留需要的操作。`actions` 只决定开哪些端点，能做什么由必填的 `policy` 决定，它同样管上传。

上传不接受调用方的任何字段（`store()` 自己合成全部值），所以上传路径绑定的是从这份 Policy 派生出来的一份：继承 `create.scope` 和 `create.defaults`，字段白名单换成文件表自己的九列。由此有三条：`create: false` 会连上传一起拒绝；`create.defaults` 里的 `{ ownerId }` 会写进上传出来的记录；`create.scope` 同样对上传生效，越界的写入回滚并清理已上传对象。要允许上传但不允许调用方自己造文件记录，就写一个不含 `fields` 的 `create` 节点，像上例那样。

`accessPath` 下的内容路由是有意的例外：它在 `/api` 之外、没有认证，Policy 不覆盖它。普通 action 复用 `defineRepositoryApiRoutes()` 的协议。
